name: Ben Adeyemi
summary: Edtech product manager experienced in user interviews who offered a user feedback session for LinkMate.

notes.text: Ben Adeyemi, product manager at Lumio (edtech, learning apps). Also at the tech meetup. Talked about user interviews and how most teams build features nobody needs.
Ben offered to run a 30-min user feedback session for LinkMate with 3-4 people from his team. Needs a working prototype first. He's also into board games, invited me to a game night.
